keys: T1: `Store.addLoan` -> `createLoan` and `Store.returnLoan` -> `closeLoan` in src, tests and notes (handlers keep their names); `grep -rn "addLoan\|returnLoan"` finds only the handler `returnLoan` in src/handlers/loans.js + src/server.js; `node --test` green; branch refactor/rename-loan-methods
T3: PATCH /books/:id with `{title:""}` or `{title:null}` answers 422 with a `title` problem, book unchanged; regression tests (API + validateBook); `node --test` green; branch fix/patch-blank-title

T5: `POST /loans/:id/renew` (7 days or integer `days` 1-30, max 2 renewals then 409, 409 returned loan, 404 unknown, 400 bad id, 422 bad body), `renewals` on every loan (0 for pre-existing stored loans), README endpoint table + behaviour note, tests; `node --test` green; branch feat/loan-renew

T2: README "Data file format" section (top-level keys, book + loan record with examples, id assignment, when written, missing file at start-up); every claim checked by a throwaway script run against the code; branch docs/readme-data-file-format

T4: notes/validation-coverage.md (`# Validation coverage`, table Endpoint | Input | Validated in | Rule | Gap with a row per input of every route incl. renew, `## Gaps` ordered by likelihood of a wrong response); every gap reproduced with a script; a check script confirms all routes/inputs have a row; branch docs/validation-coverage
Final: `node --test` green on the last branch; stack of branches/PRs recorded in Resume
